# Per-beat confidence from seed disagreement (generated by scripts/confidence.py)

22038 beats of 16 unseen development people. conf = mean pairwise r of the 3 seeds' beats; quality = r of the 3-seed mean beat with the real beat.

- Spearman(conf, quality), all beats pooled: 0.356
- within a person: median 0.334 (range -0.656 to 0.792)
